business_summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc., an attraction and hospitality company, owns and operates a collection of travel experiences in iconic destinations in the United States, Canada, Iceland, and Costa Rica. It operates various attractions and lodges with integrated restaurants, retail, and transportation facilities, as well as owns and operates eco-luxury resorts. The company was formerly known as Viad Corp and changed its name to Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. in January 2025. Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. was founded in 1926 and is based in Denver, Colorado.
business_summary_ko: 관광명소 및 환대 회사인 Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다, 아이슬란드, 코스타리카의 상징적인 목적지에서 다양한 여행 경험을 소유하고 운영합니다. 레스토랑, 소매, 교통시설이 통합된 다양한 관광명소와 숙박시설을 운영하고 있으며, 친환경 럭셔리 리조트도 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Viad Corp으로 알려졌으며 2025년 1월에 Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc.는 1926년에 설립되었으며 콜로라도주 덴버에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
